_note: 全组共用的风景维度表（JSON 不能写注释，说明放在这里）。和打分规则 a5（航拍）/ v7（街景）的 16 个维度一一对应。改了维度（增删、改名）就把 schema_version 升一版。score_range 是模型输出分数的量程，全组约定 0-1。description 会原样发给 Gemini，所以用英文写清楚。

tree_canopy.description: Trees around the route: street trees, yard and park trees, leaves overhead. The main source of shade.

forest_environment.description: Continuous woodland or forest along the route, not just scattered street trees.

grassland.description: Grass around the route: lawns, parks, sports fields, meadows, pasture.

open_landscape.description: How open the view is: broad sky and long views (fields, waterfronts, big parks). Low = closed in by buildings, dense trees or tunnels.

farmland_pastoral.description: Countryside farmland: crop fields, pasture, orchards, vineyards, farmyards.

water_access.description: Water right beside or near the route: sea, harbor, river, canal, lake, pond.

hilly_terrain.description: Hill or mountain country around the route: natural slopes, rock, ravines. About the landscape, not how steep the road is.

historic_character.description: Old or heritage buildings: historic districts, old main streets, monuments.

architectural_character.description: Distinctive buildings that stand out: unusual shapes, bold colors, a strongly local style.

street_enclosure.description: Tall buildings closing in on both sides of the street, like a city canyon with little sky.

urban_density.description: How many buildings there are and how tightly packed: dense city blocks versus open country.

commercial_district.description: Shops, cafes, storefronts, shopping streets, malls.

road_width.description: How wide the nearby road is for cars (number of traffic lanes). Wider roads usually mean more and faster car traffic.

industrial_area.description: Factories, warehouses, rail yards, ports, utility plants, derelict land.

visual_clutter.description: Overhead wires, poles, large road signs, billboards, traffic lights, overpasses.

scenic_appeal.description: How attractive the place looks overall.
